criteria.condition: Every development phase has one canonical execution question record.
criteria.evidence: PHASE0–PHASE7 records exist and validate against PHASE_EXECUTION_RECORD_SCHEMA.

criteria.condition: Accepted phases cannot retain unresolved blocking questions.
criteria.evidence: Phase 0–2 all blocking questions have answered/not-applicable post-execution answers with evidence.

criteria.condition: Future phases capture questions before implementation rather than inventing answers later.
criteria.evidence: Phase 3–7 records use prospective capture, have non-empty pre_execution_questions and zero post_execution_answers.

criteria.condition: Questions and answers are visible alongside acceptance, not hidden in chat history.
criteria.evidence: Development Plan includes per-phase questions; acceptance reviews include Q&A; PHASE_ACCEPTANCE_QA.md is generated.

criteria.condition: System Map shows Q&A/acceptance status by phase.
criteria.evidence: Map generator consumes phase records and exposes questions/answered/unresolved blocking counts.

criteria.condition: The Q&A model is enforced by release validation and generated-view parity.

note: Phase 0–2 question sets are explicitly marked retrospective because the Q&A policy was introduced after those phases; Phase 3 onward is prospective.
